# API reference

<!-- Generated by tools/export_api_docs.py from the running application. Do not edit by hand: run `python tools/export_api_docs.py`. tests/test_api_docs.py fails when this file is stale. -->

32 operations. Everything is JSON over HTTP under `/api`. The machine-readable contract is [`web/src/api/openapi.json`](../web/src/api/openapi.json) (the web app's TypeScript types are generated from it). With the API running, `/docs` serves an interactive version while `FO_API_DOCS` is not `0`.

All figures come from the synthetic-data engine. The API describes an illustrative simulation, not investment advice.

## How to call it

- **Sign-in.** `POST /api/auth/login` (or `signup`, or `demo`) sets an `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Lax` cookie named `fo_session`. Only a hash of its value is stored on the server. The cookie is also `Secure` over HTTPS or when `FO_API_COOKIE_SECURE=1`.
- **CSRF token.** The sign-in response and `GET /api/auth/me` return `csrf_token`. Send it as the `X-CSRF-Token` header on every operation marked *+ CSRF token* (all state-changing calls and the calls that run the model on posted data). A missing or wrong token gets 403.
- **Origin.** A `POST`, `PUT` or `DELETE` carrying an `Origin` header that is neither on the allowlist (`FO_API_CORS_ORIGINS`) nor the server's own origin gets 403.
- **Bodies.** Request bodies must be `application/json` (else 415) and at most `FO_API_MAX_BODY_KB` (default 256 KB, else 413). A holdings file travels inside that JSON body.
- **Errors.** Every error has the same shape, `{"detail": "…", "problems": ["…"] | null}`. The text never repeats what you submitted. Unexpected failures are a generic 500.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 401 | Not signed in, or wrong username or password. |
| 403 | CSRF token missing or wrong, or the `Origin` is not allowed. |
| 404 | Not found. A profile that belongs to another account answers exactly like one that does not exist. |
| 409 | Conflict: profile limit reached, the last profile cannot be deleted, an identical import already exists, or holdings are applied before any are imported. |
| 413 / 415 | Request body too large, or not JSON. |
| 422 | The request was not valid; `problems` lists field names and rules, never the submitted values. |
| 429 | Rate limit reached; the `Retry-After` header says how many seconds to wait. |
| 503 | The allocation model is busy (it is one shared thread); retry after the `Retry-After` header. |

## Operations

Access: **Public** needs nothing; **Signed in** needs the session cookie; **Signed in + CSRF token** also needs the CSRF header.

### Service

| Operation | Access | What it does | Request body | Query | Success | Rate limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/health` | Public | Liveness check; also opens the database once, so it fails if the database cannot be reached. | none | none | 200 JSON object | none |
| `GET /api/meta` | Public | Service facts: version, data source (sample or snapshot), disclaimer, asset classes, demo families, scenario presets and custom-scenario ranges. | none | none | 200 MetaOut | none |

### Sign-in

| Operation | Access | What it does | Request body | Query | Success | Rate limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/auth/demo` | Public | Start a private, throwaway copy of one demo family. Answers 404 when demo sign-in is switched off. | DemoRequest | none | 200 SessionOut | `demo_ip` |
| `POST /api/auth/login` | Public | Sign in with username and password. Starts a new server-side session and sets the session cookie. | Credentials | none | 200 SessionOut | `login_user`, `login_ip` |
| `POST /api/auth/logout` | Signed in + CSRF token | End the session and clear the cookie. | none | none | 204 no body | none |
| `GET /api/auth/me` | Signed in | Who is signed in; returns a fresh CSRF token for the current session. | none | none | 200 SessionOut | none |
| `POST /api/auth/signup` | Public | Create an account and sign it in. | Credentials | none | 201 SessionOut | `signup_ip` |

### Profiles and results

| Operation | Access | What it does | Request body | Query | Success | Rate limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/profiles` | Signed in | The signed-in account's family profiles (id, name, corpus). | none | none | 200 list of ProfileSummary | none |
| `POST /api/profiles` | Signed in + CSRF token | Create a profile. Validated with the same rules as the Streamlit form; 409 once the per-account limit is reached. | ProfileIn | none | 201 ProfileOut | none |
| `GET /api/profiles/{profile_id}` | Signed in | One profile in full. | none | none | 200 ProfileOut | none |
| `PUT /api/profiles/{profile_id}` | Signed in + CSRF token | Replace a profile. Validated; 404 if it is not this account's. | ProfileIn | none | 200 ProfileOut | none |
| `DELETE /api/profiles/{profile_id}` | Signed in + CSRF token | Delete a profile and its holdings imports. 409 for the last profile: an account always keeps one. | none | none | 204 no body | none |
| `GET /api/profiles/{profile_id}/analysis` | Signed in | Run the allocation model for this profile: current mix, three recommendations, risk and liquidity figures, action plan, insights. | none | `basis` (all / strict) | 200 AnalysisOut | `analysis_user` |
| `GET /api/profiles/{profile_id}/history` | Signed in | Replay the sample years for the current mix and each recommendation (drawdown history). | none | `basis` (all / strict) | 200 HistoryOut | `analysis_user` |
| `POST /api/profiles/{profile_id}/scenarios` | Signed in + CSRF token | Stress the current mix and each recommendation with a built-in scenario or the six custom dials. | ScenarioRequest | none | 200 ScenarioComparison | `scenarios_user` |

### Guided plan

| Operation | Access | What it does | Request body | Query | Success | Rate limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/plan/config` | Public | The guided plan's questions, choices and bounds. Holds nobody's data. | none | none | 200 PlanConfigOut | none |
| `POST /api/plan/preview` | Signed in + CSRF token | Instant read-out of what the answers so far mean. No optimiser, so safe to call as someone types. | PlanAnswersIn | none | 200 PlanPreviewOut | none |
| `POST /api/plan/save` | Signed in + CSRF token | Save the guided-plan answers as a new profile (answers 201) or into an existing one (answers 200). | SaveRequest | none | 200 SaveOut | none |
| `POST /api/plan/strategies` | Signed in + CSRF token | Run the allocation model on the guided-plan answers and return Strategy A, B and C. | PlanAnswersIn | none | 200 PlanStrategiesOut | `plan_user` |

| Operation | Access | What it does | Request body | Query | Success | Rate limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/holdings/template` | Public | A small, valid example import file. Holds nobody's data. | none | none | 200 TemplateOut | none |
| `POST /api/profiles/{profile_id}/holdings/apply` | Signed in + CSRF token | Make the profile's holdings the imported ones. Only this call ever changes the profile from an import. | ApplyIn | none | 200 ApplyOut | none |
| `POST /api/profiles/{profile_id}/holdings/apply/preview` | Signed in + CSRF token | What the profile would look like if the imported holdings were used. Changes nothing. | ApplyIn | none | 200 ApplyOut | none |
| `GET /api/profiles/{profile_id}/holdings/consolidation` | Signed in | All imported lines for the profile, totalled by asset class and by account. | none | none | 200 ConsolidationOut | none |
| `GET /api/profiles/{profile_id}/holdings/imports` | Signed in | The imports stored for this profile. | none | none | 200 list of ImportOut | none |
| `POST /api/profiles/{profile_id}/holdings/imports` | Signed in + CSRF token | Read the file again and, if nothing blocks it, store it as an import. 409 for a duplicate of an earlier import. | ImportIn | none | 201 ImportOut | `holdings_user` |
| `DELETE /api/profiles/{profile_id}/holdings/imports/{import_id}` | Signed in + CSRF token | Delete one stored import and its lines. | none | none | 204 no body | none |
| `POST /api/profiles/{profile_id}/holdings/preview` | Signed in + CSRF token | Read a CSV or Excel file and report what it holds and what is wrong. Stores nothing. | FileIn | none | 200 PreviewOut | `holdings_user` |

| Operation | Access | What it does | Request body | Query | Success | Rate limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/explain/catalog` | Public | The questions the Assistant can answer, grouped, with the parameters each takes. Holds nobody's data. | none | none | 200 CatalogOut | none |

## Rate limits

Counted in memory, per server process, so a restart clears them and several processes each keep their own count (see [the production checklist](production-readiness.md)). Behind a reverse proxy every visitor shares the proxy's address unless the proxy is configured to pass the real one on; the per-address limits are only meaningful when that is done.

| Name | Limit | Applies |
|---|---|---|
| `login_user` | 5 per 10 minutes | per username, counted on failed sign-ins |
| `login_ip` | 30 per 10 minutes | per client address, counted on failed sign-ins |
| `signup_ip` | 10 per 1 hour | per client address, every attempt |
| `demo_ip` | 30 per 1 hour | per client address, every attempt |
| `plan_user` | 40 per 1 minute | per signed-in account |
| `holdings_user` | 60 per 1 minute | per signed-in account |
| `explain_user` | 60 per 1 minute | per signed-in account |
| `analysis_user` | 240 per 1 minute | per signed-in account |
| `scenarios_user` | 90 per 1 minute | per signed-in account |

## Response shapes

The shape names above (for example `AnalysisOut`) are defined in `api/schemas.py`, `api/plan_schemas.py`, `api/holdings_schemas.py` and `api/explain_schemas.py`, and listed field by field in `web/src/api/openapi.json` under `components.schemas`.
